messages:
maria gomez: Heads-up: Samira Patel visit Wed 2026-04-07. Arriving SJC ~09:40. Needs wheelchair access and a private interview room. Can facilities help with ground-floor pickup?
tyler ng: I can meet at the SJC curb at 09:30 if someone confirms pickup window. I have interviews 10:00-12:30 — can we keep the schedule compact?
ash (typo) ash rao: We can reserve Room G1 (ground floor, near elevator) and arrange ADA access. Need ETA for security escort.
maria gomez: Thanks Ash. Also flagging: candidate is fasting (Ramadan) so vegetarian lunch only, no glass containers. She asked about a quiet space for a short break.
tyler ng: Noted. Can we do panels 10:00-11:00 (intro + culture), 11:15-12:00 (system design), and 1:00-2:00 (coding exercise)?
ash ash rao: That layout works. I'll request the ground-floor badge pickup and arrange escort from lobby to G1.
devex-bot: DevEx checklist: create temp org (samira-test-2026), seed small dataset, pre-clone repo on loaner. Confirmed tasks: org created, dataset seeded.
maria gomez: @badge-bot please issue visitor badge for Samira Patel, arrival 09:35, escort required. Include laptop loaner MacBook Pro with charger.
badge-bot: Visitor badge request received -> https://redwood.internal/badges/requests/1783601234 (status: pending approval).
tyler ng: Quick ask for the coding exercise: prefer Python, 45m, internet access allowed, but no external APIs. Add that to invite.
devex-bot: Coding exercise details to include in invite:
```
Repo: github.com/redwood/example-task (pre-cloned on loaner)
Language: Python 3.10
Time: 45m
Internet: allowed (no external API keys)
Test data: /data/sample.json
```
maria gomez: Expense note: Candidate has taxi receipt for airport -> policy auto-approve under $80. If hotel needed, submit pre-approval. I will DM finance contact.
ash ash rao: Parking note: Visitor lot A, please provide a printed pass (I will have it at lobby).
tyler ng: If any delays, fallback to full remote — invite should include Zoom link and "remote fallback" instructions.
badge-bot: Badge approved by security at 08:50. Loaner assigned: Asset TAG RB-5542.
maria gomez: Ill draft the calendar invite now with room, Zoom, fallback note, dietary + accessibility notes, and parking pass instructions. Tagging Tyler for final schedule confirmation.
tyler ng: Schedule confirmed. I'll prep feedback form and block 30m debrief at 14:15.
maria gomez: Sending confirmation email to candidate with parking, reception, escort, quiet room details. All set unless anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
